conclusion: Graph-based queries show measurable value for complex code understanding tasks. Simple searches should use traditional grep/rg. The devcontainer feature is justified for S-CORE's complex codebase and agent workflows.

evidence_for_maintainers.value_proposition: Saves 5-15 minutes per complex query, enables otherwise impossible analyses
evidence_for_maintainers.overhead: <1s for queries that would take 5-15 minutes manually
evidence_for_maintainers.risk: Low - feature is passive, agents choose when to use
